title: Distribution Agreement
fullText:
DISTRIBUTION AGREEMENT
Between Kestrel Instruments Limited and Lionbridge Distribution Pte Ltd
PARTIES
This Distribution Agreement is made between Kestrel Instruments Limited, a company
incorporated in England and Wales (company number 09182773) whose registered office is at 14
Wellington Court, Reading RG1 8DB, United Kingdom (the “Supplier”), and Lionbridge
Distribution Pte Ltd (UEN 202033445D), whose registered office is at 25 Tai Seng Avenue,
Singapore 534104 (the “Distributor”).
1 Definitions
“Products” means the Supplier’s benchtop analytical instruments and dedicated consumables
within Product Category X, as listed in the Schedule.
“Territory” means Singapore.
2.1 Term
This Agreement starts on 8 May 2026 and runs for twenty-four (24) months, ending on 8 May
2028 unless it is terminated earlier under clause 11.
2.3 Renewal
At the end of the Term this Agreement renews automatically for further periods of twelve (12)
months each, unless either party gives the other written notice not less than ninety (90) days
before the end of the then-current period that it does not wish the Agreement to renew.
3.1 Appointment
The Supplier appoints the Distributor as its sole distributor of the Products in the Territory.
The Supplier will not appoint any other distributor, reseller or agent for the Products in the
Territory during the Term. The Supplier reserves the right to continue to supply the Products
directly to end customers in the Territory, and any such direct sales shall not be a breach of this
clause.
6.2 Annual licence fee
The Distributor shall pay an annual licence fee of S$10,000 on 1 January in each year of the
Term, in consideration of the trade mark licence granted under clause 6.1.
10.1 Limitation of liability
Except for liability which cannot lawfully be excluded, neither party’s total liability under this
Agreement shall exceed S$250,000 in aggregate.
11.1 Termination for convenience
The Supplier may terminate this Agreement by giving three (3) months’ written notice. The
Distributor may terminate this Agreement by giving six (6) months’ written notice.
11.2 Termination for cause
Either party may terminate this Agreement by written notice if the other party is in material breach
of it and has not put the breach right within fourteen (14) days of being asked in writing to do so.

SCHEDULE — PRODUCTS AND TERRITORY
Product category: Product Category X — benchtop analytical instruments and dedicated
consumables (KI-400 series spectrophotometers, KI-650 series chromatography modules, and
associated calibration standards, sample cells and reagent cartridges).
Territory: Singapore.
Minimum annual purchase commitment: S$180,000 per year of the Term.
GOVERNING LAW AND JURISDICTION
This Agreement is governed by the laws of Singapore. The parties submit to the exclusive
jurisdiction of the courts of Singapore in respect of any dispute arising out of or in connection with
it.
